Use case

The Open Access citation advantage

Publications that claim, investigate or refute one sentence and its field-specific variants. Each sentence links to its own page.

The general sentence

Open Access publications receive on average more citations than similar publications that are not Open Access.

http://purl.org/aida/Open+Access+publications+receive+on+average+more+citations+than+similar+publications+that+are+not+Open+Access.

Pattern for more specific sentences

Open Access publications qualification receive on average more citations than similar publications that are not Open Access.
